# Adenoidectomy(Archived)

**Authors:** Benjamin J. Miller, Gunjan Gupta

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Adenoidectomy is one of the most commonly performed operations in children. Pioneered in the 19th century by Hans Wilhelm Meyer, the procedure has undergone radical evolution over the last century and a half. It now has low associated morbidity and a robust evidence base demonstrating sustained benefits postoperatively. It is primarily used as a treatment for otitis media with effusion, chronic adenoiditis, and obstructive sleep apnea in children.
